name: NO_STOPPING_MAINTENANCE_VEHICLES_EXCEPTED_WHITE_TALL

r5-35_no_standing_140.desc: AS 1743 no-stopping roundel 140 dia (R5-36), as the sheet cites

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R5-SA168 225 x 450 (2025, 1:5), R25, white, no border. No-stopping roundel R5-36 (140 dia), 30 from the top, centred — the national symbol. MAINTENANCE 35 B baseline 240 (170 + 70), ink 216 (5/216/4); VEHICLES 35 C baseline 300, 180 (23/180/22); EXCEPTED 35 C baseline 360, 185 (20/185/20). Arrow centre line 45 below (y 405), 45 from the bottom: 35/155/35. For use in maintenance bays only. Arrows are the AS 1743 R5-14 (double, 155 x 32) and R5-16 (single, 125 x 32) open-chevron arrows the sheet cites, drawn as polygons with the national dimensions (shaft 12, head 42 long x 32 wide, barbs 12 thick). This spec is the sheet's left-arrow alternative (R5-16, 125 long, centred); the sheet draws the double arrow.
